stmt_text: Compare the use of an ORM with writing raw SQL queries in a back-end web application.

Model answer:

An ORM maps tables to classes and rows to objects, so developers use their own language; it speeds development, reduces repeated code, and uses parameterised queries by default, reducing SQL injection.
